name: google-foto-manager
description: App desktop per selezionare automaticamente tutte le foto in Google Foto
author: sebastianoboem

scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run clean:release && electron-builder --mac --win && node scripts/finalize-release.cjs
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npm run clean:release && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npm run clean:release && electron-builder --win && node scripts/finalize-release.cjs
scripts.build:mac:x64: npm run build && npm run clean:release && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.build:win:x64: npm run build && npm run clean:release && electron-builder --win --x64 && node scripts/finalize-release.cjs
